Calibration training uses historical performance to build confidence-accuracy mappings, enabling dynamic adjustment of predictive priors in GSI. The Edge Lab expands analytical capabilities via tools like Kelly sizing and arbitrage scanners, each grounded in probabilistic models that inform GSE’s decision-making logic. Model Court integrates community input into a structured Q&A layer, creating a feedback loop that enhances both GSI’s interpretability and GSE’s situational awareness. These primitives collectively define a closed-loop system where user behavior, tool usage, and model evolution reinforce one another.
